paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how inference quality and KV-cache GPU memory usage vary as the recent sequence ratio changes, showing perplexity (left y-axis) and GPU memory ratio (right y-axis) as functions of the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale, spans roughly 10% to 100%, and shows regularly spaced tick labels at 20% intervals (20, 40, 60, 80, 100). The left y-axis is labeled “Perplexity”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick labels every 0.1. The right y-axis is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 40% to 100% with tick labels every 10%. An orange solid line with circular markers labeled “Perplexity” starts near 4.59 at about 10%, decreases to around 4.45 (20%), ~4.39 (30%), and reaches a low near 4.30 at 40%, then varies slightly around 4.33–4.34 (50–60%), dips near ~4.29 at 70%, rises to ~4.33 at 80%, reaches ~4.39 at 90%, and ends around ~4.38 at 100%; a red dashed horizontal reference line labeled “Full Cache PPL” is drawn at approximately 4.38 across all x-values. A blue solid line with circular markers labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio” increases gradually from about 41% at ~10% to ~42% (20%), ~43% (30%), ~44% (40%), ~45% (50%), ~46–47% (60%), ~48% (70%), then rises to ~55% at 80%, jumps sharply to about 98% at 90%, and ends near ~99% at 100%; a blue dashed horizontal reference line labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.” is drawn near the top of the right axis at approximately 98–100% across the full x-range.
